messages:
elena: Quick sync — we need a finalize GA acceptance checklist for Onramp: SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing gating. I sketched gating criteria below, please react with objections or additions.

samir: SLA numbers look aggressive for peak Dedicated bursts. Can we add an automated fallback to a cheaper/fast quantized variant when P95 > target? Also we need an explicit error budget policy. :thinking_face: 

maria: Docs checklist: public API reference, migration guide, examples (node/python), troubleshooting + known limitations + quantization guidance. Add sample configs for batching and cache.

jeff: Support ops: we should require a 30-day oncall rotation for GA customers (first 30 days post-GA) and a triage playbook. Draft link: https://intra.redwood/support/runbooks/onramp (placeholder).

linh: Monitoring owners — propose metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, request error rate, token/sec, queue length, model fallback rate. Alerts: sustained p95 > target for 3min, error-rate > 1% for 5min, rollout regressions. I can own dashboards.

elena: Ops-bot, please create a ticket for the GA checklist and assign owners.

ops-bot: Created ticket IR-3421: "Onramp GA acceptance checklist" — owners: @elena @linh @maria @samir. ETA: EOW. :white_check_mark:

samir: Pricing gating: require public pricing page + internal unit-cost model. Proposed guardrail: accept GA only if expected amortized unit-cost <= $0.003/token for small models (with caching/batching assumptions). If we can't meet that, block GA or require a premium SLA tier.

maria: For SLA verification require: 7-day performance smoke tests (production-like traffic), and 72-hour burn-in on Dedicated reservations. Capture logs for KV cache hit-rate and tail latencies.

jeff: TL;DR action list (short):
```
1) Dash & alerts -> Linh
2) Docs updates + examples -> Maria
3) SLA test harness & burn-in -> Samir
4) Support rota + triage playbook -> Elena
5) Pricing model & publish -> Finance (cc: Jeff)
```

elena: I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to close owners and acceptance criteria. If you can’t make it, drop notes in IR-3421. :calendar:
